a_before_b.rationale: Deciding whether to build or buy a model does not require first knowing how to compare model capabilities; the build-versus-buy decision focuses on cost, control, and time-to-market rather than technical model comparison.

b_before_a.rationale: Meaningfully evaluating whether to build or buy a foundation model requires understanding how to compare models by architecture, size, modality, and performance to match them with application needs.
